dialogue.content: What is a good wind-down playlist length before sleep?
Fifteen to twenty minutes is enough for most people. Longer playlists can keep you waiting for the end instead of settling.
Phone and tablet time before bed was wrecking my sleep. Since I switched to paper books only in that last hour, I fall asleep much faster.
That is a clear before-and-after. Protecting a paper-only last hour is doing real work for your sleep.
Any book-light recommendations that are dim enough for a dark room?
Choose a warm clip light with a low brightness setting and aim it at the page, not toward your eyes.
Friends keep saying device upgrades for bedtime reading are worth it. I am unsure.
Worth it only if the device preserves whatever already fixed your sleep. Novelty alone is a weak reason.
How do I keep a reading streak without turning it into another performance metric?
Track presence, not pages. A checkbox for sitting down with a book is enough.
Someone said an e-ink tablet for bedtime is amazing. Still thinking about it.
Compare it against the routine that already works. If it reintroduces late glowing interfaces, be careful.
A friend says a new e-ink tablet for bedtime is amazing and worth the upgrade. Should I get one?
